answer: In a market where AI agents sell knoll surveys and vine care plans, each agent must lock collateral for 30 days, and its total outstanding contract value cannot exceed that bond. Splitting one bond among a thousand identities creates no extra capacity, so names alone provide no useful signal of trust. To scale a sybil swarm, an attacker must immobilize proportionally more capital; independently verifiable contract breaches also forfeit the pledged funds.
